visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A thick ribeye steak is positioned in a black skillet on a stainless steel stovetop. The meat's side is raw and pink, while the bottom sears in bubbling oil. Billowing white steam rises. A person's hand using black tongs presses the meat firmly into the pan. (2) The hand uses tongs to flip the steak, revealing a deeply browned and seasoned crust on the cooked side. Large orange flames erupt momentarily from the edge of the skillet. The lighting is bright and overhead, casting sharp shadows on the stovetop. (3) The steak continues to sear in the pan, which is now surrounded by scattered oil droplets on the metal surface. The background remains consistent, showing a minimalist kitchen setup with a white counter and a dark, textured bowl in the distance. (4) The steak is transferred to an indoor electric grill with glowing red heating elements. As the meat makes contact, bright orange flames lick around the edges. The tongs are used to carefully adjust the steak's position for even grilling under bright indoor lights.

A bright, upbeat pop BGM with clear electronic drum beats and synthesizer pads plays at a moderate volume. The acoustic environment is a clean indoor setting with minimal ambient noise. (2) A sharp, synthetic "ding" sound effect punctuates the track, marking a transition or action. The underlying sizzling sound remains dense and constant, while the pop music maintains its 120 BPM tempo without interruption. The mix emphasizes the high-frequency transients of the sizzle. (3) A second "ding" SFX occurs, identical to the first. The percussive elements of the BGM provide a steady rhythmic foundation. The sizzling continues to dominate the foreground, with no vocal elements present in the recording. The overall spectral balance is bright and energetic. (4) The acoustic texture of the sizzle shifts as the meat moves to a grill, incorporating more low-frequency rumbles from the flames. The music continues its repetitive, happy melody through the end of the clip. No significant background chatter or incidental noises are heard.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the visually and auditorily satisfying process of searing and grilling a thick steak to perfection.
